artist_notes.name: OFIER b2b OREN
artist_notes.note: Another b2b pairing on the Unicorns-Only lineup — local/underground LA circuit, limited public footprint.

enrichment.curator_note: The Unicorns-Only edition is a step up from the usual Sunset Sessions residents — it's explicitly positioned as 'underground, you won't hear this on a mainstage' house and techno, with a pool-side component added. Same Level 8 rooftop, more teeth in the curation.
enrichment.description: Special edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop series at Level 8 DTLA, themed 'Unicorns-Only' — underground house/tech-house/techno b2b sets with Casmalia, 2LM, OFIER, OREN, Lady Miaou and Geshay, 5–10pm, poolside.

artist_notes.name: JKriv
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based co-founder of Razor-N-Tape (2012, 150+ releases) — jazz-trained multi-instrumentalist turned disco/house/edits DJ; Lot Radio resident, fans include Disclosure and Gilles Peterson. Sets are eclectic and groove-forward without being record-nerdy about it.

enrichment.curator_note: Razor-N-Tape has been one of the sharper disco-edits labels running for over a decade, and JKriv co-built it from scratch — catching him at The Bridge for Midnight Lovers is a solid late Friday for groove without the festival crowd. $22 pre is reasonable for the room.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers presents JKriv (Razor-N-Tape, Brooklyn) at The Bridge in DTLA — disco, edits and deep house, 10pm, $22 advance.

events.title: Sorry For Party Rocking (2010-2015 Pop & Edm All Night Long!)

enrichment.curator_note: A night built entirely on 2010–2015 EDM and pop nostalgia — LMFAO, early Skrillex, that whole era. Fun if that's the brief, but this is a full penalty on taste grounds; the only reason to go is irony or a group outing where everyone agrees.
enrichment.description: Nostalgia club night at Catch One spinning pop and EDM hits from 2010–2015, 10pm.

enrichment.curator_note: LA Discoteca is a recurring night at The Slipper Clutch doing what the name says — disco and house in a basement-y DTLA room. No headliner detail in the billing, so treat it as a low-effort add-on to a Friday that already has Yaeji or Stacey Pullen on it.
enrichment.description: LA DISCOTECA recurring disco/house night at The Slipper Clutch, DTLA, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017, debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL. A tracked name on a proper North American DJ tour right now.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

enrichment.curator_note: Lights Down Low doing what it does best: TBA location drops day-of, and they've booked Yaeji on a dedicated DJ-set summer tour — whispered-bilingual-house in a warehouse rather than a festival tent is the right format for her. Worth the address chase.
enrichment.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji DJ set (plus Alima Lee, Hu Dat, AMERICANRECYCLING) at a location-TBA downtown warehouse, 10pm, 21+.

events.title: CSW and SLINK - Enayet and K Wata [All Night] [Live / DJ]

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh using deep soundsystem pressure and South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh. Slippery, off-kilter club rhythms.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, also a SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; has produced for Yaeji and contributed to the james K remix album. The duo have played as E Wata together.

enrichment.curator_note: CSW (Costumed Suicide Watcher) and SLINK booking Enayet + K Wata all-night is a genuine curatorial swing — SLINK's whole thing is polyrhythmic club mutations that don't resolve neatly into any genre, which makes for unpredictable, genuinely interesting late nights. Different proposition from the Stacey Pullen or Robert Hood options on the same weekend.
enrichment.description: CSW and SLINK present Enayet and K Wata (SLINK, NYC) playing all night at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm, live/DJ.

events.title: MARBLE: Halo Varga, Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owns Artifact Record Shop. House and techno with deep Chicago roots and a European finish.

artist_notes.name: Dylan Payne
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — soul-forward, all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

artist_notes.name: Highkin'
artist_notes.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

enrichment.curator_note: MARBLE runs proper Arts District afterhours — a 10pm-to-7am window with Halo Varga, one of fabric's original residents, at the top of the bill. The fabric lineage plus Dylan Payne's vinyl microhouse is the right combination for anyone who wants to go deep rather than wide tonight.
enrichment.description: MARBLE afterhours at a TBA Arts District location with Halo Varga (fabric/All Inn), Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar and more, 10pm-7am, $20-37.

events.title: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty with Green Velvet and Ugo Banchi

artist_notes.name: Green Velvet
artist_notes.note: Curtis Alan Jones — Chicago house originator and founder of Cajual Records (1991) and Relief Records (1993); his Green Velvet alias is the neon-mohawked acid-house/tech-house persona responsible for 'Flash,' 'Bigger Than Prince' and countless floor-wreckers. A genuine first-generation Chicago figure, not just festival billing.

artist_notes.name: Ugo Borghetti
artist_notes.note: Could not verify as a DJ/producer on the electronic circuit — name appears to correspond to an Italian hip-hop artist; may be a local LA selector with minimal public footprint. Treating as low-confidence support act.

enrichment.curator_note: Green Velvet at an outdoor preparty the night before Day Trip Festival is a better proposition than it looks — he's a Chicago original, not a nostalgia booking, and can still lock in a proper acid-inflected set. Ugo Borghetti is an unknown variable, but this is a warm-up show, not a main stage.
enrichment.description: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty at Hollywood Park, Inglewood — Green Velvet headlines an outdoor evening with support from Ugo Borghetti, 6pm.

events.title: BAILE WORLD Pride ft Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, & More

artist_notes.name: Bambii
artist_notes.note: Jamaican-Canadian DJ/producer Kirsten Azan, Toronto — Juno Award winner (Electronic Album of the Year, 2024 for 'Infinity Club'); sets merge jungle, dancehall, UK garage, drum'n'bass and hyperpop; played Berghain, contributed to Kelela's 'Raven' album. One of the more genuinely exciting figures in this global-bass space right now.

artist_notes.name: Jubilee
artist_notes.note: NYC DJ/producer, Mixpak-affiliated — Miami bass, Baltimore club, grime and dancehall woven into high-energy sets; debut album 'After Hours' on Mixpak; South Florida rave roots and East Coast underground-scene credibility.

artist_notes.name: Introspekt
artist_notes.note: LA-born, NY-based DJ/producer — UK garage, dubstep, jungle and bass through a Black transsexual lesbian lens; debut LP 'Moving The Center' on Tempa (2023); NTS residency and Mixmag breakthrough DJ of the year 2023.

artist_notes.name: Mafra
artist_notes.note: Likely Léo Mafra, São Paulo-based DJ/producer known for bass-driven electronic sets at clubs like D-Edge — cannot fully verify this is the same Mafra on the Baile World bill; confidence low, included per billing.

artist_notes.name: Elohim
artist_notes.note: LA-based singer-producer (she performs anonymously, face covered) — moody electropop and synth-driven tracks with mental-health themes; 'She Talks Too Much' and 'Xanax' established her sound. Billed here as a DJ set rather than live show.

artist_notes.name: Lukas Galvao
artist_notes.note: No verifiable profile found on the electronic/club circuit; included per billing.

artist_notes.name: Joei Hernandez
artist_notes.note: No verifiable profile found on the electronic/club circuit; included per billing.

artist_notes.name: Nadia Khari
artist_notes.note: No verifiable profile found on the electronic/club circuit; included per billing.

enrichment.curator_note: Bambii and Introspekt on the same Pride bill is the real draw here — two of the more interesting figures working in the global-bass/UK-garage space, with Jubilee's Miami-bass carnage rounding it out. The baile funk framing is more genre-as-party-theme than a strict selector focus, but the headliners justify the night.
enrichment.description: BAILE WORLD Pride party featuring Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, Mafra, Elohim (DJ set) and others — global bass, baile funk, dancehall and queer-club energy, Pride weekend.

events.title: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present: Stacey Pullen, BAE BAE and Nish

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse, ran Blackflag Recordings, and cut the acclaimed DJ-Kicks in 1996. Known aliases: Bango, Kosmik Messenger, Silent Phase. A tracked name bringing genuine Detroit lineage to this TBA night.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave. Sets move freely through Black diasporic club music: footwork, juke, breaks, R&B; a key figure in LA's queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Nish
artist_notes.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward, soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first curatorial approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

enrichment.curator_note: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO have been landing Berghain-calibre bookings for years, and Stacey Pullen for a TBA late night is exactly that — second-wave Detroit in an intimate warehouse rather than a stage. BAE BAE warming up keeps the energy genuinely interesting rather than just competent.
enrichment.description: Dirty Epic x INCOGNITO present Stacey Pullen (Detroit techno) alongside BAE BAE and Nish at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm-4am, $25-30.

artist_notes.name: VOLTIQUE
artist_notes.note: No verified profile found — appears to be a local LA act or DJ collective; cannot confirm genre, label, or scene beyond the billing context of 'Pride techno.' Included per the event listing.

enrichment.curator_note: REVERB is the LGBTQ+ night at Catch One, one of LA's historic queer clubs, and this Pride edition has a techno focus with VOLTIQUE headlining — but with no verifiable profile on VOLTIQUE the night's ceiling depends entirely on a name I can't vet. Worth checking the door if you're already in Mid-City.
enrichment.description: REVERB: VOLTIQUE PRIDE at Catch One in Mid-City — queer Pride techno night, 10pm.

events.venue: Camille's at The Bellwether (Los Angeles) desert house, disco, psychedelic

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda. Genuinely odd and fun in the right way.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; live band performing at this Camille's date, not a DJ set. A bit outside the pure dance lane but with real groove DNA.

enrichment.curator_note: Flying Mojito Bros are a left-field booking for Camille's — their cosmic country-funk-to-acid-house sets are genuinely weird and don't fit a clean genre box, which tends to make for memorable nights. Brainstory are a live band so this is a hybrid show/club format; go for the FMB set if you want to dance.
enrichment.description: Flying Mojito Bros (cosmic disco/acid house, UK) and live soul-jazz act Brainstory at Camille's at The Bellwether, 9pm-2am, $24.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house rooted in Motown edits.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped draft the modern American tech-house blueprint; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

artist_notes.name: Josh Baker
artist_notes.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy, fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm, plus Black Book and Catch & Release.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee; Insomniac Records debut.

enrichment.curator_note: Day Trip's sixth Long Beach edition at the new Queen Mary Amphitheater is the tech-house festival LA actually needs — the Adam Beyer / Loco Dice / Hi-Lo block gives it real techno weight, and Cloonee headlining keeps it from disappearing up its own prog-house backside. Saturday is the day to go.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer with a Berghain residency — albums on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and Permanent Vacation; his 2022 'See You in Paradise' won the German Record Critics' Award. Runs his own Funnuvojere Records. Eclectic selector spanning house, Italo, electro and outsider electronics; exactly the European-club-night reference point this taste is after.

artist_notes.name: Masha Dabelka
artist_notes.note: Vienna-based, Siberian-born DJ and producer; founder of Turntablista (Austria's first private DJ school). Produces across ambient, techno and experimental; released 'Dolphins In China' EP (Fortunea Records, March 2025) blending deep house and breaks. Versatile selector with an art-music sensibility.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

enrichment.curator_note: A Berghain resident with German Record Critics' Award-winning albums playing The Bridge's Midnight Lovers format is a real booking — Pagliara's Ostgut Ton / Live at Robert Johnson lineage puts this firmly in the European-underground end that's worth staying late for. Masha Dabelka is a credible opener with a genuinely experimental edge.
